build_conditional_flow_model: build a ConditionalFlow model with input_dim, flow_dim, output_dim, and dropout parameters
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass on the ConditionalFlow model with input tensor, noise, and steps
train_conditional_flow: train the ConditionalFlow model using the learn method with input and output tensors
run_single_step: run a single integration step of the ConditionalFlow model with x_t, t_start, t_end, and x
run_model_inference: run the ConditionalFlow model inference by concatenating x_t, t, and x through the LinearEncoder
